# stalwart_tenant (Data Source)

Defines a tenant for multi-tenant environments with isolated resources and quotas. Requires an Enterprise license.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the tenant

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the tenant
- `logo` (String) URL or base64-encoded image representing the tenant
- `permissions` (Attributes) Permissions assigned to this tenant (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `quotas` (Map of String) Quotas for different object types within this tenant
- `roles` (Attributes) Roles assigned to this tenant (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `used_disk_quota` (Number) Amount of disk space currently used by this tenant (bytes)

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `disabled_permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions that are explicitly disabled, even if they would be inherited through other roles or groups. This takes precedence over enabled permissions.
- `enabled_permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions that are explicitly enabled.
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `role_ids` (Set of String) List of roles assigned to this principal.
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
